Treatment summary
The patient presented following a sideswipe collision that occurred while the other
vehicle was changing lanes. The reported mechanism of injury is consistent with a
concussion from a collision of this type, and the presenting symptoms matched that
picture. Imaging and examination findings clearly confirm the diagnosis of concussion.
No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient history or from
available records. Over the course of care, the patient completed 15 visits, a
somewhat longer course than is typical for this injury, reflecting a gradual recovery
with intermittent headaches, light sensitivity, and concentration difficulties. Each
visit was documented separately, and the billing records reflect single, distinct
charges for each encounter with no repeated or duplicate entries. Symptoms improved
steadily under a graduated return-to-activity plan, and the patient was advised to
continue follow-up should any symptoms recur.

injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.

it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
